secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing secret for local session auth. Generated for development; replace with a strong value (openssl rand -base64 32) for production.

secrets.name: ASAAS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Asaas API key for PIX/card payment integration. Only needed when processing real payments; not required for local-mode boot.

secrets.name: ASAAS_ENVIRONMENT
secrets.description: Asaas environment: 'sandbox' or 'production'. Defaults to sandbox.

secrets.name: ASAAS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN
secrets.description: Token for verifying Asaas payment webhooks. Optional in development; required in production.
